tool_input.description: Run scratch program to inspect real formatPeriod output for the javadoc example dates

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DurationFormatUtilsAgentTest.java` with 30 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `formatDuration`, `formatDurationHMS`, `formatDurationISO`, `formatDurationWords`, `formatPeriod`, `formatPeriodISO`, and the package-private `lexx`/`Token` machinery, including boundary cases (zero duration, `Long.MAX_VALUE`, negative duration, `startMillis > endMillis`, malformed patterns like unmatched quotes/optional blocks and nested optional blocks, fully-empty optional-block output). All 30 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
